jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Leuven.

In this role, you will be a key pillar of our 6-member financial department, taking ownership of accounting tasks from A to Z.

To succeed, you must be experienced in Belgian and familiar with international accounting principles, highly analytical, and possess an high attention to detail. Your goal will be to drive the overall efficiency of our financial operations, ensure the accuracy and compliance of the day-to-day accounting and manage the month end closing process.

• Support the AP accountant with incoming invoices in accordance with Belgian accounting and VAT principles
• Manage the AP invoice approval cycle efficiently.
• Take ownership of the AP accounting for our subsidiaries (Germany, The Netherlands, UK, Finland, and Singapore). 
• Support bookings and meticulously reconcile bank statements.
• Register journal entries payroll bookings for Belgium and international entities.
• Manage fixed assets and book depreciations across all subsidiaries.
• Register prepaid expenses, accruals, and provisions.
• Prepare and file Belgian VAT returns, as well as VAT filings for foreign subsidiaries.
• Lead the monthly closing process for all corporate entities.
• Assist with group-level financial reconciliations, consolidation and reporting.
 

• Education: minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Accountancy) or equivalent experience.
• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Belgian accounting rules and VAT.
• Languages: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) alongside a good working knowledge of Dutch.
• Skills: Strong analytical acumen, great comfort with numbers, and an uncompromising attention to detail.
• Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of Belgian accounting and financial reporting practices. Advanced knowledge of MS Office is required.
• Pluses: Previous experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Encore Pro Group builds software for live entertainment and culture. With Encore Pro and Yesplan, venues and event organisers manage their operations and connect with audiences. Our products serve theatres, concert halls and event venues across the Benelux, and our group is growing in Europe, the UK, the United States and beyond. We have engineering labs in Ghent and Edinburgh, and offices in London, Reykjavik and New York.
 

We are looking for an Accounting Specialist to support our international group. You will combine hands-on bookkeeping with financial reporting and help improve the way we work across entities, countries and systems.

· A degree in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and relevant bookkeeping or accounting experience.
 

· A sound understanding of reconciliations and closing processes, with a careful, reliable and structured approach to deadlines.
 

· Strong Excel skills and confidence with accounting software; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.
 

· Strong English communication skills; additional languages are welcome.
 

· The ability to work independently and collaborate with an international team. Experience with multiple entities, intercompany accounting or subscription-based businesses is a plus.
 

· A practical, proactive mindset and an interest in process improvement and automation.

Location : Belgium

Start date : ASAP

Duration : 3 - 6 months + extension(s)

Senior IT Project Manager - Workforce Management Application

Context & mission

We are looking for a Senior IT Project Manager to lead a Workforce Management project, covering the analysis of RFP responses and the implementation of an application delivered by an external supplier.

The solution will support employee scheduling, working time management and employee evaluations.

You will coordinate HR stakeholders, IT teams, Procurement and external partners throughout supplier evaluation, implementation and rollout. Knowledge of HR processes and experience delivering a similar project are highly desirable.

Description :

• 
RFP analysis & supplier evaluation: Analyse supplier proposals against business and technical requirements, compare implementation approaches, identify gaps and risks, and support supplier selection.

• 
Project management: Lead the full project lifecycle, managing scope, planning, budget, resources, quality and change.

• 
Business & IT coordination: Work with HR stakeholders, Business Analysts and technical teams to clarify requirements and ensure the solution meets business needs.

• 
Supplier management: Coordinate the selected supplier's activities, monitor commitments and deliverables, and manage dependencies with internal teams.

• 
Application implementation: Oversee configuration, integrations, data migration and deployment of the supplier-delivered application.

• 
Testing & UAT: Coordinate testing and user acceptance with HR and business teams, ensuring issues are addressed before go-live.

• 
Reporting & governance: Prepare weekly status reports, Steering Committee presentations and PMO updates, following established project management standards.

• 
Risk & issue management: Identify risks, track mitigation actions and resolve or escalate issues.

• 
Change & rollout: Coordinate communication, training, business readiness and transition to operational support.

• 
Team leadership: Functionally manage up to five team members, including Business Analysts, developers and testers.

 

Your profile :
Education & languages

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent.

• 
Good understanding of current and emerging technologies.

• 
Native French or Dutch required, combined with  Fluent English.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in IT project management in a business or industry environment.

• 
Proven experience implementing business applications delivered by external suppliers.

• 
Experience analysing RFP responses, evaluating supplier proposals and supporting solution selection.

• 
Strong supplier management and coordination skills.

• 
PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication and executive reporting skills.

• 
Experience managing budgets, planning, risks and project dependencies.

• 
Ability to lead projects independently and coordinate business and technical teams.

Preferred experience

• 
Previous implementation of a Workforce Management solution or a similar HR application.

• 
Knowledge of HR processes, particularly workforce planning, employee scheduling, time and attendance, and employee evaluations.

• 
Experience with application integrations and data migration.

• 
SAP knowledge is a strong plus.

• 
A retail/Supply background is an asset.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem and Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about logistics? Join our team at SAESB as a Logistics Administrator and play a vital role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across our operations.

Your role:
Are you detail-oriented, well-organized, and interested in logistics processes? We are looking for a Logistics Administrator to manage the entire administrative process for shipping and receiving goods. You will ensure timely deliveries while monitoring compliance with customs regulations.

Your responsibilities:
Administrative support for goods movement:

• Prepare shipping and receiving documents (such as Air Waybills and pro forma invoices).
• Create and follow up on purchase requisitions and orders in the ERP system.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date data in IT systems.
Transport coordination:

• Schedule and monitor all transport bookings, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Customs compliance:

• Verify and ensure adherence to applicable customs laws and regulations.
• Review documents for inbound and outbound shipments.
Reporting:

• Prepare and submit periodic reports on imports and exports.

Your Impact:

• Serve as the first point of contact for daily transport-related queries.
• Ensure timely and complete administrative handling of shipments and related reporting.
• Maintain proper documentation for customs and compliance purposes.

Your profile:

• A higher education degree.
• Solid proficiency in MS Office and ERP systems.
• Practical knowledge of ADR regulations, customs laws, and Incoterms (or willingness to follow training).
• Understanding of logistics operations, including both road and air freight.
• A structured and precise approach, consistently following established procedures.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset, able to anticipate and prevent issues.
• Flexibility to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
• Able to work independently after a six-month training period.
• Proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, sufficient for both internal communication and contacts with external suppliers.

jobs.occupation: Order picker in day shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - International clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected Belgian boutique advisory firm founded by two former lawyers from leading international law firms. The organization supports high-profile prestigious clients and their families throughout every stage of their personal and professional journey.

Combining legal expertise, wealth structuring coordination, contract advisory, estate planning support, tax coordination, and day-to-day administrative assistance, the firm delivers a unique and highly personalized service to a portfolio of more than 100 clients across Belgium and internationally.

With a close-knit team of around 10-15 professionals, the company offers an entrepreneurial environment where quality, trust, and excellence are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Advise and assist clients on a wide range of legal matters.
• Review, draft, and coordinate contractual documentation.
• Support matters relating to estate planning, wealth structuring, insurance, and family law.
• Coordinate real estate transactions, including purchase agreements, leases, and notarial processes.
• Liaise with external advisors including notaries, tax experts, accountants, and legal counsel.
• Provide practical support regarding social security, invoicing, and administrative matters.
• Organize and structure client files while ensuring excellent follow-up.
• Monitor deadlines, legal documentation, and ongoing projects.
• Deliver pragmatic and solutions-oriented legal guidance.
• Communicate legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Belgian Master's degree in Law 
• Legal professional as from 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.
• Strong analytical skills and legal reasoning.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Detail-oriented, critical thinker, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Fluent in Dutch & English
• Proactive and hands-on personality.
• Mature enough to work autonomously while knowing when to seek guidance.
• Genuine willingness to learn and develop.
• Comfortable working in an environment where responsibility comes early.

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Lead the migration of HR processes into the Shared Service Centre, including documentation, training, and go-live activities.

• Act as the main point of contact for HR leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and status reporting.

• Drive change management, communication, and training initiatives to support successful adoption.

• Establish performance metrics, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement programs to enhance service quality.

 

We are looking for an experienced HR transformation professional who can lead the design and implementation of a new HR Shared Service Centre in an international environment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.

• At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR Shared Service Centres.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, international HR transformation or shared services projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills.

• Excellent communication skills and fluent English.
